name: SectionTitle
label: Section title
description: Heading with a divider line and optional trailing content for organising page sections.

props.name: title
props.description:
Section heading text.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which SectionTitle does not expose.

props.name: divider
props.description: Whether to draw the bottom divider line. Set false above content that draws its own lines (bordered tables, calendars), so the section separates by whitespace alone.

props.name: anchor
props.description:
Give the heading an id and a "#" link to itself, shown on hover and
focus, as Heading's `anchor` does. `true` makes the id from the title;
a string sets it. The id lands on the heading, not the root, so an
`id` passed through goes to the root and the link targets the anchor.

props.name: anchorLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the anchor link, given the title. Defaults to "Link to <title>".

alternatives.name: PageHeader
alternatives.when: the heading is the page’s own title, with its breadcrumb and actions

alternatives.name: Heading
alternatives.when: the heading needs a level or type tier of its own rather than a section’s divided title
